# Saksham Agarwal | Software & Applied AI Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Saksham Agarwal, a Computer Science student at VIT Bhopal University, Class of 2027. The portfolio presents applied AI, full-stack, and backend projects, credentials, and contact details.

## Profile
- B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering at VIT Bhopal University, CGPA 8.46/10.
- Interests: computer vision, explainable AI, natural-language application generation, and collaborative web applications.
- Design Team Lead, FinTech Club at VIT Bhopal University.

## Selected projects
- Deepfake Forensics with Explainable AI: a research platform combining 15 forensic signals, EfficientNet-B4, Grad-CAM/SHAP, SyncNet, and PDF reports. The resume and project README report 99.81% accuracy on the official Celeb-DF v2 test and 99.96% on 140k Real & Fake Faces. These are dataset-specific benchmarks, not guarantees for arbitrary media. Source: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/Deepfake-Forensics-with-Explainable-AI
- Natural Language App Compiler: four chained Gemini stages for intent parsing, interface generation, schema synthesis, and cross-layer refinement. Source: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/NL-App-Compiler
- DocPilot: a clinical management platform with Firebase role-based authentication, Appwrite updates, and Gemini-assisted consultation notes. Source: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/Docpilot
- NexusBoard: a collaborative infinite whiteboard built with React, Canvas API, Socket.IO, and Node.js. The resume reports testing with 50 concurrent users per room and 0.56ms median synchronization latency under its test conditions. Source: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/NexusBoard
- Last-Mile Delivery Tracker: a FastAPI, React, and Leaflet logistics application with delivery tracking, dynamic ETA calculations, and interactive maps. Source: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/Last-Mile-Delivery-Tracker
- Malware Detector: a Python and Flask static triage tool combining hash signatures, YARA rules, PE entropy, and VirusTotal API lookups. Source: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/Malware-Detector

## Interactive portfolio
The 3D workstation, particle sculpture, drawing canvas, pipeline walkthrough, gravity playground, and Signal Run arcade are browser experiences. Project architecture diagrams and code sketches illustrate the concepts; they do not report live project telemetry or execute the external projects.

Certificate previews and issuer verification links are available in the portfolio. Credentials include AWS Certified AI Practitioner, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, and coursework from IBM, Google, NPTEL, L&T EduTech, and VIT Bhopal.
